title: achillea barrelieri f. schouwii
intro: Achillea barrelieri f. schouwii, commonly known as a type of Yarrow, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Achillea barrelieri f. schouwii include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
